$comment: Inputs for the independent acceptance audit (plan Part F; design-testing section 6). One item per binding requirement. tests[] use the selector syntax of scripts/acceptance/matrix.json. liveValidation.status: N/A | BLOCKED | NOT_DEPLOYED | OWNER_APPROVAL | EXTERNAL. report.js lists every non-N/A live status under blocked[]; an item with no evidence is NOT VERIFIED for the arbiter, never PASS.

gitBaseline.$comment: Recorded read-only on 2026-10-16 before this work (git rev-parse / for-each-ref). report.js compares the live refs against these.

items.title: Satellite never blocks a decision
items.requirement: Satellite never blocks a decision under any policy; the engine waits only for policy.engineWaitsFor minus NON_BLOCKING_STEPS = {satellite}.
evidenceRequired: VJ-20 and VF-3/VF-4 under all three policies
E2E-14 decision shown while satellite is pending
code trace of NON_BLOCKING_STEPS in verificationJobs.service.js

items.title: Satellite never changes a decision
items.requirement: Satellite and weather results never flip a decision under v1.1 (supporting evidence only).

items.title: Claim window measured at first submission
items.requirement: Timeliness uses firstSubmittedAt (falling back to the earliest submitted audit); waiting can never turn into a window rejection.
evidenceRequired: MGA-4 backfill picks the earliest audit

items.title: Dead satellite and weather jobs never open review cases
items.requirement: Satellite runs independently including reschedules; dead satellite/weather jobs are logged and shown in diagnostics only.

items.title: v1.1-safe-ai is the default policy
items.requirement: New versioned policy v1.1-safe-ai is the default; AI-only 'no damage' leads to a hold plus one review case.

items.title: Provider failures never become adverse decisions
items.requirement: Provider failures and malformed output make the component unavailable, then retry, then review; never rejected or more_evidence_required.
